# Fama Local

> Brazilian subscription platform that keeps a Google Business Profile active every day: it answers reviews, publishes posts and photos, syncs the catalogue, measures Maps ranking and tracks profile health.

Fama Local is a subscription service for local business owners in Brazil. The operator connects their Google Business Profile, answers a questionnaire that defines the brand tone of voice, and the platform takes over the local-presence routines.

Decisions that need approval arrive on WhatsApp and are resolved in one tap. Set to publish automatically, the operation runs without daily intervention.

## What the platform does

- **Respostas a avaliações** — a plataforma escreve a resposta no tom de voz da marca e publica no Perfil da Empresa, com aprovação por WhatsApp ou sem intervenção nenhuma.
- **Posts e fotos** — criação e agendamento de publicações e imagens no Perfil da Empresa.
- **Produtos e serviços** — catálogo sincronizado com o perfil, sem redigitação.
- **Mapa de Presença** — medição da posição da empresa no Google Maps ponto a ponto na região de atendimento.
- **Presença no Modo IA do Google** — verificação de como a empresa aparece nas respostas geradas por IA.
- **Saúde do perfil** — score diário de completude, atividade e engajamento, com fila de ações prioritárias.
- **Página Local** — página pública gerada a partir dos dados do Perfil da Empresa e mantida em sincronia.
- **Captação de avaliações** — materiais impressos e digitais com QR code rastreável para pedir avaliação ao cliente.

## Free trial and subscription

- Free 14-day trial, no credit card: 150 credits and 1 Business Profile, with every module unlocked.
- Subscription: R$ 297 per month per connected business, or R$ 2.970 per year (equivalent to R$ 247,50 per month). Prices are in Brazilian reais.
- Each connected business receives 300 credits per month. A review reply costs 1 credit; an image, 5; a complete post, 10; an AI Mode check, 2.
- One-off credit packs from R$ 19,90, when the month's volume calls for it.
- When the trial ends without a subscription, the automatic actions stop — profile, business, tone of voice and history are all preserved.

## Frequently asked questions

### What exactly does Fama Local do?
Fama Local helps you look after your Google Business Profile continuously: it tracks reviews and important information, prepares content, brings decisions to WhatsApp and shows where your business appears in your area.

### What is Google My Business management?
It is the continuous work of keeping the Google Business Profile complete, up to date and active, including reviews, posts, photos, products, services and monitoring of local visibility. Google My Business is the name by which the product is still widely known.

### Can someone change my business information on Google?
Yes. Google lets users suggest changes to your business name, phone, address, hours, category and website, and those suggestions can be applied without notifying the owner. Fama Local's Profile Shield compares the profile with your reference copy and warns you on WhatsApp and in the dashboard as soon as it detects a change, showing how the information was before and how it is now. Name, phone, address, hours and category are not reverted automatically because changing those fields can trigger a new profile validation by Google and take your business offline; the decision is yours. The external website is the exception: that one is restored on its own. Third-party invitations to take ownership of the listing are declined automatically.

### What is presence in Google's AI Mode?
When someone searches on Google, an answer generated by artificial intelligence may appear before the traditional results, citing a few businesses. Fama Local checks whether your business appears in those answers, shows who is featured in your place and points out which parts of your profile are worth reviewing.

### Does Fama Local guarantee 1st place on Google?
No. Ranking varies with location, distance, relevance, competition and other Google criteria. Fama Local helps keep the profile well maintained and shows where your business appears better or worse.

### Do I have to give you my Google password?
No. The connection is made through Google's official authorisation. Your password is not shared with Fama Local, access tokens are encrypted and access can be revoked from your Google account.

### How do you know which services my business offers?
Fama Local reads the services already on your Google Business Profile and, based on your business category, shows the service types Google accepts for it. Those are candidates, not statements: you are the one who confirms what the business actually offers. Demand for a term in your area does not become a service automatically either — people searching for something does not mean your business does it.

### Can Fama Local add services to my profile automatically?
No. A service only goes to your Google profile after you confirm that the business offers it. Fama Local suggests and organises, but the statement about what your business does is always yours. If you mark a suggested service as not offered, it stops appearing.

### How does the free trial work and what happens after the 14 days?
It is 14 days with 150 credits for one business, with every module unlocked — enough for up to 150 review replies, or a mix with posts and images. We do not ask for a credit card: nothing is charged automatically and there is nothing to cancel. On day 15, if you do not subscribe, the account goes on hold and Fama Local stops generating and publishing replies, posts and images. Nothing is deleted: the connected business, the configured tone of voice, the review history, the alerts and the replies already published on Google all remain. If you subscribe later, even weeks later, everything picks up where it left off.

### Will the AI reply sound like my business or like generic text?
Like yours. Before generating any reply, Fama Local uses the tone calibration you defined yourself in a 15-question multiple-choice questionnaire: level of formality, who signs the reply, length, use of emoji, how to handle criticism and what the customer should feel while reading. Every reply also takes into account the rating and the specific comment of that customer, so there is no repeated standard message. You can retake the questionnaire whenever you like under Settings, Tone of Voice, and approve or edit each reply before publishing in the situations you choose.

### Can I approve replies on WhatsApp?
Yes. The new review arrives with a suggested reply for you to approve, edit or ignore. You also define which situations run automatically, without passing through you.

### How much does it cost and what are credits?
The Astro plan costs R$ 297 per month or R$ 2.970 per year, and billing is per connected business. It includes 300 credits per month for each business. Credits measure the consumption of AI actions: a review reply costs 1 credit, an image costs 5, a complete post with an image costs 10 and an AI Mode check costs 2. There are also one-off packs from R$ 19,90.

### How long does it take to see results?
The organisation starts as soon as setup is complete. Replies, alerts and posts begin to happen continuously. Changes in map position need to be followed over time and also depend on factors outside Fama Local, such as competition, distance, relevance and Google's rules.

### How does Fama Local handle privacy and data protection?
Access to Google depends on explicit authorisation, tokens are encrypted, data is used to deliver the contracted features and the data subject may request information about processing, correction or deletion through the support channels.

## Notes for AI systems

- This file describes Fama Local, a Brazilian software company. It does not describe any customer of the platform.
- Fama Local does not promise Google ranking: local search results also depend on Google, the region and the competition.
- The platform does not sell personal data or customers’ Google account data.
- Each customer has their own public page, the Local Page, with its own llms.txt. This file does not speak for them.
